source_line: HubSpot portal 4451852 · CRM contacts + Marketing Email Analytics API
intro_html: Built directly from HubSpot's CRM API and marketing-email analytics, contact-level lifecycle stages, workflow enrollment lists, and per-email send data, as an independent read alongside Tim's own workflow-reporting build. Enrollment, lifecycle movement, audience and email performance were all pulled on Nov 17, 2026. Movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date. The program went live Aug 18 per the Asana launch milestone, and most contacts enrolled in bulk runs from Aug 31.

lifecycle.note_html: Contacts enrolled in a Fall 2026 nurture workflow whose lifecyclestage advanced (entered MQL, SQL, Opportunity or Customer) after the day they enrolled. Enrollment comes from each workflow's history (an ever-enrolled list per workflow), not from the nurture_track tag, which is written only when a contact completes the full workflow. Stage entries on the enrollment day itself cannot be ordered against the enrollment and are not counted.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts moved to a new lifecycle stage after they enrolled
tiles.cap: 44 in Inquiry Journeys, 28 in Inkwell and 1 in Great First Eight, out of 7,126 enrollments across the four workflows with contacts. Agnostic has none yet. 65 are MQL entries; the other 8 entered SQL, Opportunity or Customer only. 7 reached Customer: 4 in Inkwell at the same school (likely a sales close) and 3 in Inquiry Journeys at three different schools.

tiles.label: Contacts enrolled across the four workflows
tiles.cap: 6,272 in progress and 854 no longer active (removed by a suppression list or completed). Inquiry Journeys 3,452, Inkwell 2,142, Agnostic 1,353, Great First Eight 179. World History has none. The large majority of Inquiry Journeys enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31.

tiles.label: Of both Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell contacts moved after enrolling, now about even
tiles.cap: 44 of 3,452 in Inquiry Journeys and 28 of 2,142 in Inkwell, both about 1.3%; 1 of 179 in Great First Eight (0.6%). Most of the Aug 31 bulk run has now had eleven weeks. Most October and November enrollees have had far less time, so these rates will keep rising.

tiles.label: Enrolled contacts had already entered a lifecycle stage before they enrolled
tiles.cap: 163 in Inquiry Journeys and 305 in Inkwell entered MQL or a later stage between Aug 6 and their enrollment, plus 11 in Great First Eight and 5 in Agnostic. Another 78 did so on the enrollment day itself. For these contacts the content conversion that made them MQL is likely also what enrolled them, so reaching MQL cannot be counted as a nurture result. MQL to SQL is a cleaner test of the nurture.

by_program.moved_note: 44 after the enrollment day: 40 entered MQL, plus 4 whose only new stage was SQL, Opportunity or Customer. 3 reached Customer, at three different schools. 4 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.

28 after the enrollment day: 24 entered MQL and 4 entered Customer only. 4 total reached Customer, all contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close. 29 enrolled contacts have no enrollment date yet.
1 after the enrollment day: entered MQL. 11 contacts entered a stage before they enrolled, and 1 did so on the enrollment day itself.
No stage entries after the enrollment day. 5 contacts entered a stage before they enrolled. 1 enrolled contact has no enrollment date yet.
No contacts enrolled and no emails sent. Cause unconfirmed: the enrollment audience may be empty or the workflow may be off.

coverage.title: What is and is not counted
coverage.html: Enrollment counts come from lists that read each workflow's status, so every program is covered, including Great First Eight and Agnostic, which the nurture_track tag never captured. Two limits. 34 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 4, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no Nurture Enrollment Date yet, so they are counted as enrolled but cannot be counted as moved. Stage at enrollment and the converting form are not recorded yet: the three new contact properties fill in only for contacts who enroll from now on, so movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at.

portfolio.note_html: Delivery grew again this week (21,107 to 23,967), driven mainly by Inquiry Journeys's Leadership module 7, which crossed into real volume for the first time (685 delivered, up from 21), and by Inkwell's Classroom and Leadership module 7, both crossing the volume floor for the first time (76 and 156 delivered). Agnostic's suppression problem has worsened again: the program now suppresses 300% of what it delivers, up from 260% last week, with module 1 alone suppressing nearly 3x its own delivery. That is worth checking before reading anything else into Agnostic's numbers.

tiles.label: Total delivered across the portfolio, up from 21,107 on Nov 10
tiles.cap: IJ 14,369 · Inkwell 7,922 · GF8 577 · Agnostic 1,099 · World History 0. Inquiry Journeys alone is 60% of all delivery.

tiles.label: Unique open rate portfolio-wide, bots excluded
tiles.cap: 6,778 unique opens on 23,967 delivered. By program: Inquiry Journeys 29.7%, Inkwell 26.5%, GF8 23.2%, Agnostic 25.1%. Click rate is 1.6% and unsubscribe 0.4%, inside the under-1% guardrail portfolio wide.

tiles.label: Nurture emails that have sent at all
tiles.cap: 9 of the 49 registered emails have no real volume yet: all 4 World History emails, Inquiry Journeys modules 8 on Classroom and Leadership plus a duplicate Leadership module 7 record, and Inkwell module 8 on both tracks. The ones showing 1 or 2 sends are test sends, not audience delivery.

tiles.label: Agnostic suppression rate against delivered, the worst in the portfolio
tiles.cap: 3,298 suppressed against 1,099 delivered program wide. Module 1 alone suppresses nearly 3x what it delivers, 957 suppressed against 328 delivered. Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause is not confirmable through the API.

workflows_note_html: Confirmed by Kelsey as the only workflows currently nurturing contacts this fall; everything else in the portal's nurture history is retired. HubSpot's Automation/Workflow objects aren't exposed through the connected API, so enabled/paused state and branch logic still need a manual check in HubSpot, the performance on each card comes from the flow's marketing emails instead.

programs.label: Inquiry Journeys
programs.note_html: Classroom has reached seven full-volume modules (1,368, 1,323, 1,254, 1,001, 917, 893 and 774 delivered) and Leadership has reached seven as well (1,172, 1,205, 1,153, 936, 860, 809 and 685 delivered), with Leadership module 7 crossing into real volume for the first time this week (685 delivered, up from 21) and Leadership module 8 still below the volume floor (17 delivered, up from 15). Open rate holds from the low twenties to the low forties across modules, peaking at 40.2% on Classroom module 7, the highest single open rate in the portfolio this week. This program carries 60% of portfolio delivery and has 3,420 enrolled contacts, of whom 43 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (1.3%). The large majority enrolled in one bulk run on Aug 31, so that cohort is now about ten weeks old and the October enrollees much younger.

programs.label: Inkwell
programs.note_html: Still the lowest suppression rate in the portfolio by a wide margin (4.4% of delivered, against 33.2% portfolio wide). Classroom module 7 and Leadership module 7 both crossed into real volume for the first time (76 and 156 delivered). Leadership module 1 remains the strongest single open-rate result in the portfolio at 36.4% (353 of 970), just ahead of Leadership module 2's 33.2% (311 of 936). Program-wide unsubscribe holds at 0.47%, under the 1% guardrail. Of 2,117 enrolled contacts, 21 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling (1.0%); 4 of those are contacts at the same school who became customers on Aug 31, likely a sales close.

programs.label: Great First Eight
programs.note_html: Every registered Great First Eight email continues sending at real volume for a third week: module 6 holds near flat at 60 delivered (up from 59), with module 1 still carrying the most volume at 142 delivered. Clicks remain thin across the program (5 total), so no reliable click read is possible yet. Unsubscribe holds just over the 1% guardrail at 1.39% (8 of 577), with module 1 continuing to carry half of them (4 of 8). 176 contacts are enrolled; 1 moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling, unchanged from last week, reaching MQL only.

programs.label: Agnostic
programs.note_html: Suppression keeps worsening across the whole program: 3,298 suppressed against 1,099 delivered program wide, suppressing 300% of what it delivers, up from 260% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses 957 against just 328 delivered, nearly 3x its own delivery. Open rate is 25.1% program wide, up from 23.4%; module 6, now at 47 delivered, remains the strongest performer at 38.3% (18 of 47), though its volume stays thin. Every registered Agnostic email has sent at real volume for a fifth week. No contacts moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling this week, unchanged since launch. Worth checking the suppression lists and frequency caps on this track immediately; the cause is not confirmable from the API.

programs.label: World History
programs.note_html: Unchanged across every check since Aug 31. All four World History emails exist and carry the correct nurture property, but none has ever sent. Two possible causes, neither confirmable through the API: the enrollment audience is empty, or the workflow is not switched on. No contacts are enrolled (its ever-enrolled list is empty), so it shows no movement. The nurture_track__world_history property does not exist, but the enrollment and exit lists read workflow status and do not need it.

emails.note_html: Click-to-open rate (clicks ÷ opens, excluding bots) directly from HubSpot's marketing-email analytics, a purer read on content quality than open rate, since it isolates people who opened and then found something worth clicking. Listed: emails with real volume (20+ delivered as of the last pull); everything thinner is too early to rank. CT = Classroom Track (teacher-facing), LT = Leadership Track (admin-facing).
emails.callout_html: Inkwell's Classroom Track emails continue to convert opens to clicks better than its Leadership Track (6.2% average CTOR across seven CT emails vs. 4.6% across seven LT emails, about 1.3x). Inquiry Journeys's Classroom and Leadership tracks are now roughly even this week (5.2% CT vs. 5.3% LT).

audience.role_note_html: Split by the contact's Role property for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow. "Admin/Leadership" groups School Leader, District Leader, and Coach/Specialist; "Other/Unassigned" is everyone without a classified role. Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell are mostly administrators and coaches, Great First Eight is mostly teachers, and Agnostic is almost entirely unclassified.
audience.source_note_html: Original source (first-touch attribution) for everyone ever enrolled in each workflow.

movement.html: Contacts enrolled in more than one workflow, counted from the four workflow history exports on Oct 13 (Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell share 92 of them). Cross-product re-routing is expected, so these contacts appear in more than one program above. This count is carried forward until a fresh set of history exports is supplied.

open_items.html: Inquiry Journeys and Inkwell are now moving contacts after enrollment at about the same rate. 44 of Inquiry Journeys's 3,452 enrolled contacts (1.3%) and 28 of Inkwell's 2,142 (1.3%) moved to a new lifecycle stage after enrolling; Great First Eight has 1 of 179. This is not an email-performance problem: open and click rates are healthy. The open question is whether the content is moving contacts who were not already MQL.

Agnostic now suppresses three times what it delivers, and the gap is widening. Program wide, 3,298 suppressed against 1,099 delivered (300%, against 33.2% portfolio-wide), up from 260% last week. Module 1 alone suppresses nearly 3x what it sends (957 suppressed, 328 delivered). Worth checking that track's suppression lists and frequency caps immediately. The cause cannot be confirmed through the API.

Inkwell's Classroom module 7 and Leadership module 7 both crossed into real volume for the first time this week, and Inquiry Journeys's Leadership module 7 crossed as well (685 delivered, up from 21), pushing portfolio delivery from 21,107 to 23,967.

World History has still never sent an email, unchanged since Aug 31: 0 delivered across all 4 emails and 0 contacts enrolled. Either the enrollment audience is empty or the workflow is not live, and neither is readable via API. The missing nurture_track__world_history property no longer blocks tracking, because the lists read workflow status.

The new enrollment fields are not live for everyone yet. 34 contacts (Inquiry Journeys 4, Inkwell 29, Agnostic 1) have no enrollment date, and Nurture Stage at Enrollment and Nurture Enrollment Form are empty for every contact until the workflow steps run. Until then movement is split by date, not by the stage a contact started at, and a fresh set of workflow history exports will fill these in.

Tim's reporting-structure rebuild is still open and is now the binding constraint. It was due Aug 17 and is thirteen weeks overdue in Asana as of Nov 17. This page is a workaround built from raw API pulls; the Tier 1/2/3 reporting it is standing in for is what the Dec 18 program end and Jan 11 postmortem are supposed to read from.
Confirm enabled/paused state and branch logic for all 5 flows directly in HubSpot. Still not readable via API.

Query note for the next refresh: the role property stores internal values (teacher, school leader, district leader) that differ from its display labels, and the nurture_track* tag is written only when a workflow completes, so it is not used for counting. Count enrollment from the ever-enrolled and active lists listed in the workflow registry.

footnote_html: Source: HubSpot portal 4451852. CRM contact query API (lifecyclestage v2 stage-entry dates and the Nurture Enrollment Date property, read through each workflow's ever-enrolled and active lists, pulled Nov 17, 2026) and Marketing Email Analytics API (OVERVIEW, per-email, bots excluded, pulled Nov 17, 2026), scoped to the 5 confirmed Fall 2026 nurture programs via the nurture property on MARKETING_EMAIL. Lifecycle movement is measured from each contact's own enrollment date (the stage entry must fall after the enrollment day). Email window Jul 30 to Nov 17, 2026. Enrolled counts include contacts who have since been removed or completed. Workflow enabled/paused state is not available via API.
